## EXHIBIT "A" – WAGE SCALES

Minimum Wage Scales effective November 10, 1962 to May 8, 1965, applicable to Store Employees, members of Local No. 72, Amalgamated Food Employees Union chartered by Amalgamated Meat Cutters and Butcher Workmen of North America, AFL-CIO working in Acme Markets, Inc. Division No. 5 (with headquarters in Forty Fort, Pennsylvania) stores and markets.
